name: brand-search
title: Brand Search
author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>
description: Company autocomplete backed by the Logo.dev Search API: a debounced combobox with logos per result, plus a Next.js route that keeps your secret key on the server.
docs: Set LOGO_DEV_SECRET_KEY (sk_) in .env.local — server-only, never expose it to the browser. Get keys at https://www.logo.dev/dashboard. Not on Next.js? Re-create the proxy from app/api/logo-dev/search/route.ts in your backend and pass `endpoint` to useBrandSearch.
